name: M5.BinaryRecovery.recover_positive
statement: ∀ (c : List Bool → ℤ) (p : List Bool) (n : ℕ), (∀ q : List Bool, q.length < p.length + n → c q = c (q ++ [false]) + c (q ++ [true])) → 0 < c p → 0 < c (M5.BinaryRecovery.recover c p n)
guidance: Induct n generalizing p. At successor, the split law applies atp. If false-child count>0 use it; otherwise parent positivity and count split force true-child count>0 by omega. For the recursive split hypothesis, the length bound (p++[bit]).length+n equals p.length+(n+1). No global nonnegative assumption is needed. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact statement.
